notes.claim: A coordinate pair is written with x first and y second, so x comes before y, and plotting means going along first and then up or down.
A V-I graph for an ohmic conductor is a straight line through the origin, which shows that current and voltage are proportional.

sources.title: What are axes and coordinates when drawing graphs? (KS3 Maths | BBC Bitesize) - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: One way to remember is 'you go along the hallway before you go up the stairs'.

sources.title: What are axes and coordinates when drawing graphs? (KS3 Maths | BBC Bitesize) - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: Coordinates are written alphabetically - so x comes before y (x, y).

sources.title: What is Ohm's Law? - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: the V-I graph is a straight line that passes through the origin, this shows that the current and voltage are proportional

sources.title: PE1.2: OHM'S LAW
sources.quote: The graph of V versus I is a straight line that must go through the origin.
